rules:
1. Every number comes from one record (its record_id is given next to it) or is a count / median of records.
 2. Units are converted only inside a unit group (UNITS below); a unit outside every group gets its own row with
    direction 'none'.  µ (U+00B5) and μ (U+03BC) are treated as the same character.
 3. Each record contributes one value, after unit conversion:
    a. for a range or list (value_num .. value_num_hi) the better end for the parameter's direction: the upper end for
       'max'; for 'min' the smallest end above zero (a sweep that starts at 0 is not a value of 0), except in dBm;
    b. value_num for direction 'none';
    c. A6 and E2 'bandwidth' given as a range of wavelengths (both ends >= 200 nm) is an operating band: the value is
       its width (upper end minus lower end).
 4. Best value: the largest ('max') or smallest ('min') value among the records of that status; ties are broken by
    record_id.  Not eligible: a bound that points the wrong way ('<', '≤', '<=' for 'max'; '>', '≥', '>=' for 'min'),
    because the true value is then worse than the number written; and, for 'min', a value of zero or below (except
    in dBm).  Direction 'none' gives no best value (the parameter has no better direction, or the records mix tasks,
    e.g. E1 accuracy, F1 task_metric, J accuracy - the benchmark ledger splits J accuracy by task).
    best_measured_calc = 'yes' when the best record's condition or note says the value was calculated or estimated
    (the class rules still count it as measured; see the README of PNN_params).
 5. measured_min / median / max are over measured records only.  Simulated and predicted records are counted and
    have their own best values, never mixed with measured ones.
 6. Year = the two digits after the journal name in the paper's file name; tier = library folder (01..04 -> T1..T4).
 7. Material families: a record joins a family through its class label (label rule) or through a material name in
    its material_text (text rule; chemical formulas are matched case-sensitively).  Text rules are not applied to A3
    (its label names the active phase-change material); several families skip classes where the material is usually
    only a substrate, electrode or dielectric there (listed per family as 'skip'); 'phase-change materials (other or
    unspecified)' takes by text only records not already in a named PCM family.  A record can be in several families.
 8. Benchmark task: the first task rule that matches the record's condition (then value_text).  A record that matches
    no rule and whose condition says 'same' ('same network', 'same task', ...) takes the task of the previous accuracy
    record of the same paper.  Anything else is 'unspecified'.
